text:
mira: FYI PR #18422 needs to land before the Friday deploy blackout (schema change). CI is stuck on integration tests, asking for quick eyes and a rebase suggestion.
aj: Where's the failing job? link?
ci-bot: Build 98421 — integration-suite — failed on `db-migration-test` (timeout). logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/98421
kevin: I can look, but if the migration touches the schema we should aim to land during the pre-freeze rebase window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. That avoids the blackout on Friday.
olivia: I can do a review pass now, ping me when CI is green. If it's flaky I can mark the migration tests as `flaky:investigate` in the test config for the rerun.
aj: Mira, can you rebase onto main and force-push a test-only run? If it's just a transient timeout a rerun should clear it. If it's deterministic, we need the migration tweak.
mira: Rebase in progress. Using:
```bash
git checkout pr/18422
git fetch origin main
git rebase origin/main
# fix conflicts
git push --force-with-lease
```
mira: Pushed the rebase at 1717777788, kicked CI.
ci-bot: Build 98422 queued — triggered by mira (rebase).
kevin: If the rerun still times out, can we narrow down the test and run only the `db-migration-test` locally? Saves CI cycles.
olivia: +1. Also @aj can give quick approval after green, then we schedule the land during the 09:00 slot. If we hit another flake we fallback to canary-only rollout.
aj: Will watch the build. If green I'll approve and assign to release manager for the pre-freeze slot.
ci-bot: Build 98422 — integration-suite — passed. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/98422/artifacts
aj: Approved. @release-manager can we reserve the 09:00-11:00 PT rebase window for this? If not, we can do a canary cut tonight but prefer pre-freeze slot.
mira: Thanks everyone. Plan: land in pre-freeze window, run canary for 30m, promote if no regressions. If any flaky failures surface we revert and open a follow-up. :thumbsup:
kevin: Sounds good. I'll be on-call during the window and can abort if latency spikes show up.
olivia: I'll post a short checklist in the release thread (DB backup, rollback command, feature-flag toggle) before the window.
mira: Posting rollback steps here for quick access:
```text
rollback:
  1) disable feature flag: `ff toggle schema-migration --off`
  2) revert migration release tag: `git revert -m 1 <land-commit>`
  3) restore DB snapshot if needed
```
mira: Last note — if anyone needs to land earlier, shout now. Otherwise see you at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
